description: This file implements network socket handling for a web server, including socket initialization, event handling, socket activation, and cleanup. It manages TCP/Unix sockets, socket options, and integrates with systemd socket activation.

methods.name: network_accept_tcp_nagle_disable
methods.description: Disables Nagle's algorithm on a TCP socket if not inherited from listen socket.

methods.name: network_server_handle_fdevent
methods.description: Handles incoming events on server sockets, accepts new connections, and manages socket options.

methods.name: network_abstract_socket_enc
methods.description: Encodes abstract socket paths for systemd socket activation.

methods.name: network_host_normalize_addr_str
methods.description: Normalizes and encodes socket address into string form.

methods.name: network_host_parse_addr
methods.description: Parses address string into socket address structure, supporting IPv4, IPv6, and Unix sockets.

methods.name: network_srv_sockets_append
methods.description: Appends a server socket to the server's socket list.

methods.name: network_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration plugin values into socket config.

methods.name: network_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into socket config.

methods.name: network_srv_token_colon
methods.description: Finds the position of the colon in a server socket token string.

methods.name: network_srv_socket_init_token
methods.description: Initializes the server socket token buffer and colon position.

methods.name: network_server_init
methods.description: Initializes a server socket, binds, listens, and sets socket options.

methods.name: network_close
methods.description: Closes all server sockets and cleans up resources.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_to_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for systemd socket activation based on active sockets.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_nfds
methods.description: Initializes sockets from systemd socket activation environment variables.

methods.name: network_socket_activation_from_env
methods.description: Reads environment variables to set up socket activation sockets.

methods.name: network_init
methods.description: Main initialization function for network sockets, handling configuration, socket creation, and activation.
